title: The Letter in the Lamp

SCENE: The lamp room, night. The brass lamp is cold and a letter lies on the logbook.
Narration: The lamp is cold. A letter lies on the logbook.
ON SCREEN: Mara (dripping), Kessler (reading over her shoulder)
MARA: It is addressed to the keeper.
INSERT: a white envelope with a broken seal
KESSLER (quiet): Open it, then.
Narration: The letter says the boat turned south before the storm.
MARA (determined): Then the lamp can call it back.
SFX: a match striking
KESSLER: There.
